description: List inbound purchase orders that are receiving exceptions — POs sent to the supplier (issued, receiving, partiallyFulfilled, pendingReceiptResolution, pendingReconciliation) that are stuck. Each row carries every bucket it matches (buckets OVERLAP): overdue (past its due date), partial (some but not all ordered quantity received), blocked (a human decision is required before receiving can proceed). Optional bucket filter (overdue/partial/blocked; omit for any bucket) narrows to one; unknown values are rejected. Optional warehouseId / supplierId filters (AND-combined). Rows also carry diagnostic exceptionReasons (supplier_overdue, awaiting_remainder, receipt_pending_resolution, receipt_pending_reconciliation, cost_variance_unresolved, quantity_variance_unresolved). Ordered by due date ascending (nulls last). Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500. A client-pinned token sees only its own client's POs; an operator token sees the whole tenant's.

bucket.description: Restrict to a single bucket: overdue, partial, or blocked. Omit for any bucket.

warehouseId.description: Only POs whose destination warehouse is this id.
